summary.zh: 编排结账清单、完成对账并解释账目波动
summary.en: Plans the close, proves reconciliations, explains variances

description.zh: 用于月末或季末结账：按依赖关系排出结账任务和关键路径，把银行流水或明细账与总账核对并追踪未清项，撰写或复核差异说明，并找出结账耗时过长的原因。适合财务团队在结账周期内推进进度，或复盘为什么总拖到最后几天。
description.en: Runs a month- or quarter-end close: orders tasks by dependency, finds the critical path, proves each reconciliation and ages what is left. Writes or reviews variance explanations and diagnoses a slow close.
